covered_by_queue.label: yap
covered_by_queue.gloss: This means talking on and on without pause, filling every silence with chatter and running on at length whether or not anyone is listening or wants to hear it.

sonnet.reason: Both describe incessant talking that fills every silence; 'yap' adds obliviousness to the listener, while 'chattering' stresses a quick, light stream of small remarks.

opus.reason: Both describe incessant talk that fills every silence. Yap adds a negative emphasis on going on regardless of the listener, while chattering stresses a light, quick stream of small remarks, so they differ mainly in emphasis.
